data.title: In HelloNation, Audiology Expert Dr. Elizabeth Welch of Franklin, TN Explains How Hearing Aids Work and Who Can Benefit
data.description: In Franklin, Tennessee on October 2, 2026, a recent HelloNation article discussed the benefits of hearing aids beyond just increasing volume. Specifically, it elaborated on how hearing aids can enhance speech clarity and alleviate listening fatigue for adults dealing with mild to moderate hearing impairment. This information is crucial for approximately 48 million Americans suffering from hearing loss.
